title: A storage room
description: Two rows of crates showing what they hold on their faces, the eight upgrades framed above them, and the network's deposit box and interface box at the end of the row.

title: The three tiers
description: Basic, sturdy and reinforced crates, each face showing its item and count; a locked crate draws its count in gold.

title: A crate with every upgrade
description: A reinforced crate holding 1,024 cobblestone per slot under a stack upgrade, with its ingots compressed into blocks, its worn pickaxes repaired into one, and an enchanted sword's levels banked.

title: The disenchant upgrade
description: Enchantments come off whatever goes in; the upgrade holds their worth in levels until you right-click to collect.

title: The upgrades
description: Lock, void, three levels of stack, compress, disenchant and repair, each on the same iron plate.

title: The network
description: Connection blocks carry the network; a deposit box sorts what you drop in to the crate that already holds it, and an interface box shows everything at once.

title: The interface box
description: Every kind of item across every crate on the network, with its total, in one screen.
